in_marathi.name: Akshita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akshita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aksh' meaning 'eye' and 'Ta' meaning 'inexhaustible'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Akshara, the embodiment of the eternal and immutable aspect of the universe, is named Akshita. The name symbolizes the timeless and infinite nature of the universe and the divine power that sustains it.

vedic_reference.note: The name Akshita is derived from the Sanskrit word Aksh (Eye) and the suffix -ita, which means 'that which is'. In Hindu mythology, the eyes are considered the seat of knowledge and the source of vision. Thus, Akshita can be interpreted as 'The One Who Bestows Knowledge' or 'The One Who Possesses Knowledge'.
